profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazing Charts
profile.summary:
I am a person who like learn every day, the challenge are part of the life and they make the interesting; I like coding, analyze and design application combining several technologies.

I like to finish all the project that I start, following the best coding practices and standards. 

About programming languages, most of my carrier has been focus on Java web application in the back-end,and front-end, but I like to work/learn new or different languages/frameworks, such as mongoDB, python, node.js, machine learning, big data, could computing, unity, lucene.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Designing and implementing solutions to bugs in the application
-Researching application behaviors that no one knew in order to suggest improvements
-Writing test cases for the changes in the code
-Implementing RESTful services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing web pages in both sides, Front end and Back end.
- Support for the current web application, mainly fixing view layer problems.
- Analyzing and designing core components (Web pages, Web Services) for the new web Application.
- Implementing the new designs into the web application, using Java and Porlet technologies.
- Leading a couple of coworkers in the different areas of the new web application.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
- Supporting both-camp programs with java technologies and Agile Methodology
- Developing prove of concepts applications with different technologies.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible for troubleshooting that be reported by users in the “Insurance Ready” Portal.
- Develop new functionalities on the Portal.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
- I improved the stability of the Portal in 20%.
- I improved the response time of the main pages in 60%.
- I reduced number of registers in the Data Base in 30% through depuration.
- I made 90% of the re-engineer of the new Lawyers Portal.
- I supervised one outsourcing company that was contracted by TELCEL.
- Responsible for make all the work flow involved in a new functionality, such as to analyze the requirement, documentation, development, testing and release to production.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible for develop the module “Resources of Revision” for INFOMEX Portal.
- Responsible for develop password recovery in a secure way.
- I improved the response times of the pages of the system SISI using Ajax.
- I solved the necessities of field dependent validations using struts 2 validation framework.

positions.title: SIGHO Operator
positions.description:
- Responsible for develop a web system for to manage the stocktaking of PCs in the Hospital.
- Responsible for systems department during had to be on call.
- Technical support for all work stations in software and hardware problems.
